paragraphs: We are a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry's most complete digitally-enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries, including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoor, pet and more. We have an established and diverse group of national and regional retailers, local merchants, manufacturers, buying groups, industry associations and healthcare service providers, which we refer to as our "partners." We connect our partners and consumers through our dynamic financial ecosystem and provide them with a diverse set of financing solutions and innovative digital capabilities to address their specific needs and deliver seamless, omnichannel experiences. We utilize a broad set of distribution channels, including mobile apps and websites, as well as online marketplaces and business management solutions like point-of-sale platforms. Our offerings include private label, dual, co-brand and general purpose credit cards, as well as short- and long-term installment loans and consumer banking products. During 2025, we financed $182.3 billion of purchase volume, and at December 31, 2025, we had $103.8 billion of loan receivables and 70.7 million active accounts.

Our business benefits from longstanding and collaborative relationships with our partners, including some of the nation's leading retailers and manufacturers with well-known consumer brands, such as Lowe's and Sam's Club, and also leading digital partners, such as Amazon and PayPal. We believe our business model has been successful because it aligns our interests with those of our partners and provides substantial value to both our partners and our customers. Our partners promote our credit products because they generate increased sales and strengthen customer loyalty. Our customers benefit from instant access to credit, discounts, or other benefits such as cash back rewards and promotional offers. We seek to differentiate ourselves through our deep industry expertise, our long history of consumer lending, our innovative digital capabilities and our diverse product suite. We have omnichannel (in-store, online and mobile) technology and marketing capabilities, which allow us to offer and deliver our credit products instantly to customers across multiple channels. We continue to invest in, and develop, our digital assets as we aim to ensure our partners are well positioned for the rapidly evolving environment. We have been able to demonstrate our digital capabilities by providing solutions that meet the needs of our partners and customers, with approximately 60% of our consumer revolving credit applications in 2025 processed through a digital channel.

We conduct our operations through a single business segment. Profitability and expenses, including funding costs, credit losses and operating expenses, are managed for the business as a whole. Substantially all of our revenue generating activities are within the United States and are aligned through five sales platforms (Home & Auto, Digital, Diversified & Value, Health & Wellness and Lifestyle). Those platforms are organized by the types of partners we work with, and are measured on interest and fees on loans, loan receivables, active accounts and other sales metrics.

We offer our credit products primarily through our wholly-owned subsidiary, the Bank. In addition, through the Bank, we offer, directly to retail, affinity relationships and commercial customers, a range of deposit products insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation ("FDIC"), including certificates of deposit, individual retirement accounts ("IRAs"), money market accounts, savings accounts and sweep and affinity deposits. We also take deposits at the Bank through third-party firms that offer our FDIC-insured deposit products to their customers. Our deposit base has continued to serve as a source of stable and diversified low-cost funding for our credit activities. At December 31, 2025, we had $81.1 billion in deposits, which represented 84% of our total funding sources.
We offer our credit products through five sales platforms: Home & Auto, Digital, Diversified & Value, Health & Wellness and Lifestyle.
Set forth below is a summary of certain information relating to our sales platforms: Home & Auto

Our Home & Auto sales platform provides comprehensive payments and financing solutions with integrated in-store and digital experiences through a broad network of partners and merchants providing home and automotive merchandise and services, as well as our Synchrony Car Care network and Synchrony HOME credit card offering. Home & Auto accounted for $5.7 billion, or 26%, of our total interest and fees on loans for the year ended December 31, 2025.

Our Home & Auto sales platform partners include a wide range of key retailers in the home improvement, furniture, bedding, flooring, appliance and electronics industries, such as Ashley HomeStores Inc., Floor & Decor, Lowe's, and Mattress Firm, as well as automotive merchandise and services, such as Chevron and Discount Tire. In addition, we also have program agreements with manufacturers, buying groups and industry associations, such as Generac, Nationwide Marketing Group and the Home Furnishings Association.
At December 31, 2025, the length of our relationship with each of our five largest partners was over 10 years, and in the case of Lowe's, 46 years.

Our Digital sales platform provides comprehensive payments and financing solutions with integrated digital experiences through partners and merchants who primarily engage with their consumers through digital channels. We enable our partners to deepen consumer engagement by embedding payments and financing solutions, delivering compelling value and rewards, and providing personalized offers within seamless experiences. We also work with our partners to extend digital relationships to in-person commerce. In addition to our partner products, we also offer a Synchrony-branded general purpose credit card. Digital accounted for $6.4 billion, or 30%, of our total interest and fees on loans for the year ended December 31, 2025.

Our Digital sales platform includes key partners delivering digital payment solutions, such as PayPal, including our Venmo program, online marketplaces, such as Amazon, and digital-first brands and merchants, such as the QVC Group, Inc., Verizon and Virgin Red.

The Digital sales platform maintains strong alignment with its partners, including several well-established long-standing relationships. At December 31, 2025, the length of our relationship with each of our three largest partners was over 10 years, and in the case of PayPal, 21 years. The Digital sales platform has highly engaged customers and aims to continue to drive penetration and everyday use by expanding products, channels, and deeper user experience integrations.

headings: Risk Factors Relating to Our Business
Macroeconomic conditions could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.
Our results of operations and growth depend on our ability to retain existing partners and attract new partners.
Our results depend, to a significant extent, on the active and effective promotion and support of our products by our partners.
Our results are impacted, to a significant extent, by the financial performance of our partners.
Competition for partner relationships in the consumer finance industry is intense.
Competitive dynamics in the consumer credit and payments industry may adversely impact our ability to attract and retain customers, and the utilization of our products.
We may be unable to successfully develop and commercialize new or enhanced products and services.
Cyber-attacks or other security breaches could have a material adverse effect on our business.
The failure of third parties to provide various services that are important to our operations could have a material adverse effect on our business and results of operations.
Disruptions in the operation of our and our outsourced partners' technology environments could have a material adverse effect on our business.
Our remote work arrangements may have an adverse impact on our business.
We have international operations that subject us to various international risks as well as increased compliance and regulatory risks and costs.
Our allowance for credit losses may prove to be insufficient to cover losses on our loans.

Adverse financial market conditions or our inability to effectively manage our funding and liquidity risk could have a material adverse effect on our funding, liquidity and ability to meet our obligations.
paragraphs: We are providing the following summary of the risk factors contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K to enhance the readability and accessibility of our risk factor disclosures. We encourage you to carefully review the full risk factors contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K in their entirety for additional information regarding the material factors that make an investment in our securities speculative or risky. These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the following:
•Macroeconomic conditions could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.

•Our results of operations and growth depend on our ability to retain existing partners and attract new partners. Further, a significant percentage of our interest and fees on loans comes from relationships with a small number of large retail partners, and the loss of any of these partners could adversely affect our business and results of operations.

•Our business is heavily concentrated in U.S. consumer credit, and therefore our results are more susceptible to market fluctuations and legislative and regulatory developments in that market than a more diversified company.
•Our results depend, to a significant extent, on the active and effective promotion and support of our products by our partners, and on the financial performance of our partners.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家首屈一指的消費金融服務公司，提供業界最完整的數位化產品組合之一。我們的經驗、專業知識與規模涵蓋廣泛的產業，包括數位、健康與 wellness、零售、電信、住宅、汽車、戶外、寵物等。我們擁有已建立且多元的全國與區域零售業者、地方商家、製造商、採購團體、產業協會及醫療服務提供者，我們稱之為 "合作夥伴"。我們透過動態的金融生態系統，將合作夥伴與消費者連結，並為他們提供多樣化的融資解決方案與創新數位功能，以應對其特定需求並提供順暢的全通路體驗。我們運用廣泛的分銷渠道，包括行動應用程式與網站，以及線上市集與業務管理解決方案，例如銷售點平台。我們的產品包括自有品牌、雙品牌、合作品牌與一般用途信用卡，以及短期與長期 installment 貸款與消費者銀行產品。在 2025 年，我們資助了 1823 億美元的購買新增額，且在 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們擁有 1038 億美元的貸款應收款與 7070 萬個活躍帳戶。

本公司業務受益於與合作夥伴長期且合作的關係，包括美國一些領先的零售業者與製造商，擁有知名消費品牌，例如 Lowe's 與 Sam's Club，以及領先的數位合作夥伴，例如 Amazon 與 PayPal。我們相信本公司商業模式的成功，是因為它使我們的利潤與合作夥伴的利益一致，並為合作夥伴與客戶創造顯著價值。合作夥伴推廣我們的信用產品，因為它們能增加銷售並強化客戶忠誠度。客戶則能立即取得信貸、折扣或其他好處，例如現金回饋獎勵與促銷活動。我們透過深厚的產業專業知識、長期的消費者貸款經驗、創新數位功能與多元的產品組合來區隔自己。我們擁有全通路（實體店面、線上與行動）的科技與行銷能力，使我們能透過多個通路立即為客戶提供與交付信貸產品。我們持續投資並發展數位資產，以確保合作夥伴能適應快速變化的環境。我們已能透過提供符合合作夥伴與客戶需求的解決方案，來展現我們的數位能力，其中在 2025 年，約 60% 的消費者循環信貸申請是透過數位渠道處理的。
我們透過單一業務分部進行營運。獲利與費用，包括資金成本、信貸損失與營運費用，均以整體業務為單位進行管理。我們幾乎所有的收入產生活動均位於美國，並透過五個銷售平台（住宅與汽車、數位、多元化與價值、健康與 wellness、生活方式）進行整合。這些平台是根據我們合作的夥伴類型進行組織，並以貸款利息與費用、貸款應收款、活躍帳戶及其他銷售指標進行衡量。

我們主要透過本公司全資子公司提供信貸產品。此外，透過該銀行，我們也直接向零售、親屬關係與企業客戶提供一系列由美國聯邦存款保險公司（"FDIC"） insure 的存款產品，包括存款憑證、個人退休帳戶（"IRAs"）、貨幣市場帳戶、儲蓄帳戶與 sweep 與親屬關係存款。我們也透過第三方機構在銀行收取存款，這些機構向其客戶提供我們的 FDIC 保險存款產品。我們的存款基礎持續作為我們信貸活動穩定且多元的低成本資金來源。在 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們擁有 811 億美元的存款，佔我們總資金來源的 84%。
我們透過五個銷售平台提供信貸產品：住宅與汽車、數位、多元化與價值、健康與 wellness、生活方式。
下列為與我們銷售平台相關資訊的摘要：住宅與汽車
本公司居家與汽車銷售平台提供完整的付款與融資解決方案，透過廣泛的夥伴與商家網路，整合實體與數位體驗，提供居家與汽車商品與服務，以及本公司 Synchrony Car Care 網路與 Synchrony HOME 信用卡方案。居家與汽車業務在 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年，佔本公司貸款利息與手續費總額的 57 億美元，或 26%。

本公司居家與汽車銷售平台的夥伴包括居家改善、傢俱、牀墊、地板、家電與電子產品產業的廣泛關鍵零售商，例如 Ashley HomeStores Inc.、Floor & Decor、Lowe's 與 Mattress Firm，以及汽車商品與服務，例如 Chevron 與 Discount Tire。此外，本公司亦與製造商、採購團體與產業協會簽有方案協議，例如 Generac、Nationwide Marketing Group 與 Home Furnishings Association。
2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司與五大主要夥伴的關係長度均超過 10 年，其中 Lowe's 的關係長度為 46 年。

本公司數位銷售平台提供完整的付款與融資解決方案，透過夥伴與商家提供整合的數位體驗，這些夥伴與商家主要透過數位通路與消費者互動。本公司協助夥伴深化消費者參與，透過嵌入付款與融資解決方案，提供有吸引力的價值與回饋，並在流暢的體驗中提供個性化優惠。本公司亦與夥伴合作，將數位關係延伸至實體商業。除了夥伴產品外，本公司亦提供 Synchrony 品牌的通用用途信用卡。數位業務在 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年，佔本公司貸款利息與手續費總額的 64 億美元，或 30%。
本公司數位銷售平台包括提供數位付款解決方案的關鍵夥伴，例如 PayPal，包括本公司 Venmo 程式，線上市集，例如 Amazon，以及以數位為先的品牌與商家，例如 QVC Group, Inc.、Verizon 與 Virgin Red。
數位銷售平台與其夥伴保持強勁的協調關係，包括數個長期穩定的合作關係。2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司與三大主要夥伴的關係長度均超過 10 年，其中 PayPal 的關係長度為 21 年。數位銷售平台擁有高度參與的消費者，並致力於透過擴展產品、通路與更深層的用戶體驗整合，持續推動市場滲透與日常使用。

headings: 總體經濟、戰略及運營風險
與本公司業務相關的風險因素
總體經濟狀況可能對本公司業務、營運成果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
本公司營運成果與成長取決於本公司維持現有夥伴及吸引新夥伴的能力。
本公司營運成果在很大程度上取決於夥伴對本公司產品的積極且有效的推廣與支持。
本公司營運成果受合作夥伴財務表現影響甚鉅。
消費者金融產業中，爭取合作夥伴關係的競爭非常激烈。
消費者信貸與付款產業的競爭態勢可能不利於本公司吸引及留住客戶，以及產品的使用率。
本公司可能無法成功開發及商業化新產品或增強型服務。
網路攻擊或其他安全漏洞可能對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。
第三方未能提供對本公司營運至關重要的各項服務，可能對本公司業務及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
本公司及其委外夥伴之科技環境營運中斷，可能對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。
本公司遠端工作安排可能對業務造成不利影響。
我們有國際營運業務，因此面臨各種國際風險，以及增加的合規與法規風險及成本。
我們的信用損失撥備可能不足以彌補我們貸款所產生的損失。
不利的金融市場情勢或我們無法有效管理資金及流動性風險，可能對我們的資金、流動性及履行義務的能力產生重大不利影響。
paragraphs: 我們提供以下風險因素摘要，以提升本年度報告表 10-K 中風險因素之可讀性與可近性。我們鼓勵您仔細審閱本年度報告表 10-K 中完整之風險因素，以取得更多有關投資本公司證券為具投機性或風險性之重要因素之資訊。這些風險與不確定性包括，但不限於以下內容：
•總體經濟條件可能對本公司業務、營運成果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
•本公司營運成果與成長取決於我們保留現有夥伴並吸引新夥伴之能力。此外，我們對貸款之利息與手續費收入有相當比例來自與少數大型零售夥伴之關係，若失去任何這些夥伴，將對本公司業務與營運成果造成不利影響。
•本公司業務高度集中於美國消費者信貸，因此本公司之營運成果較 diversified 公司更容易受到該市場之市場波動與立法與監管發展之影響。
•本公司營運成果在很大程度上取決於夥伴對我們產品之積極且有效之推廣與支援，以及夥伴之財務表現。
